title: Why does gold feel harder to trade than stocks or indices?
summary: I’ve been trading for a few years now and feel comfortable with equities and indices, but gold (XAUUSD) just feels different.Fake breakouts, sudden reversals, moves that ignore clean technical setups. I keep hearing people say “gold is manipulated,” but that feels like a cop-out.Is gold actually harder to trade, or am I just approaching it the wrong way?submitted by/u/Karina-Harry[link][comments]
